sn51.12:1.1: cattāro’me bhikkhave, iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā.
sn51.12:1.2: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca kho bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā:
sn51.12:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti:
sn51.12:1.4: “iti kho me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati, na ca atippaggahito bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṅkhitto bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati,
sn51.12:1.6: yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure,
sn51.12:1.7: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho,
sn51.12:1.8: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā”.
sn51.12:1.9: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.12:2.4: iti kho me vīmaṃsā na‘ca atilīnā bhavissati. na ca atippaggahitā bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃṅkhittā bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati,
sn51.12:2.6: “yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure,
sn51.12:2.7: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho,
sn51.12:2.8: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.”
sn51.12:2.9: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.12:2.10: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā.
sn51.12:3.1: evaṃ bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: “ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti” …pe…
sn51.12:4.1: evaṃ bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
